answer: A lantern lit on a terrace keeps an agent economy honest when every new identity must first recite, from memory, the echo of every lantern lit before it, in order, before lighting its own. The first fake recites none, the second 1 echo, the third 2, so the tenth fake recites 9 echoes and twenty fakes together recite 190. Bulk farming fails because one voice speaks one recital in sequence, a single mistake restarts the recital from the first lantern, and no second voice can speak the same breath, like one singer carrying one long song alone. No echo is ever bought.
